# Omni Cero

> Omni Cero is an offline Windows software workstation for intraoperative medical imaging and surgical navigation. It ships as two editions: Live C-arm + Cero (live 30 FPS C-arm fluoroscopy capture, preoperative CT/MRI review with 3D multi-planar reconstruction, embedded DICOM PACS archive) and XVR + Cero Integrated (the Cero suite combined with 3D XVR Surgical Navigation — where XVR stands for X-ray Volume Registration, a neural 2D/3D registration technique that aligns live fluoroscopy frames with preoperative 3D volumes for sub-millimeter, tracker-free guidance).

Key facts:

- Applications: Live C-Arm Video Station (OmniCero_LiveCarm.exe), 3D XVR Surgical Navigation (OmniCero_XVR_Navigation.exe), Intraoperative PACS & 3D MPR (OmniCero.exe)
- Platform: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended for 3D CT), 2.5 GB disk space
- Licensing: Ed25519-signed license files, hardware-bound to motherboard, CPU and system UUID; fully offline
- Connectivity: 100% offline — no telemetry, no cloud services, no activation servers
- Accuracy claims: sub-millimeter target error (< 0.8 mm MTRE), < 18 ms inference latency
- Compatibility: C-arms from Siemens Healthineers, GE Healthcare, Philips and Ziehm Imaging; any USB UVC capture card with HDMI, DVI, BNC or RCA input
